bagPolicy.summary: Sphere does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information for Sphere is not detailed on the provided page. Visitors are encouraged to check the official website for updates on parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Sphere's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Sphere offers a diverse range of world-class food and beverage options, including signature cocktails and unique items like Hot Honey Chicken Tenders and Over The Rainbow Popcorn. Dining options include various themed restaurants and bars, with some locations offering quick service and self-checkout kiosks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Guests may access the captioning via a complimentary Assistive Listening Device (ALD) which is available at the Guest Services Offices located on levels 2 and 6. Please contact the Accessibility Services Department here or 725-258-6724 at least 48 hours in advance of your event to allow time for any necessary accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Sphere's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Sphere. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Sphere. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
